about: QAFINAL-FU-VOL: what a list page may cost at hundreds of items, written down before the first measurement (R30-LAT, 2026-11-12) and held by perf/volume-*.perf.spec.ts with every API served by the spec (no stack, no model). A page is loaded twice, with `small` items and with `large`; `extraRequests` is how many more API requests the large load may make than the small one (0: no request per item, the list's first page only), and `readyMs` is navigation to the page's data drawn at `large` items. SLO.md, 'Volume (QAFINAL-FU-VOL)', states the same numbers and why.

grounds.extraRequests: A list page asks for one page of its list and names what it holds in that answer or one batched lookup: no request per row (an N+1 fails at any N).
grounds.readyMs: EV-15: a conversation of 10,000 steps is usable within 2 s of navigation (perf/chat-large-run.perf.spec.ts); a list of hundreds is held to the same 2 s.
